notes: The flagged three-morpheme unit אֲשֶׁר ... עָלֶיהָ → whereon is genuinely indivisible under rule 22; contiguity is not the condition, so the intervening verb does not break it.

The ASV's the great stone answers to a reading of אָבֵל as אֶבֶן; the packet marks no variant unit here, so the English is aligned as printed against the token the projection carries (rule 53), and the versional note corroborates without deciding (rule 38).

both of ... and of ... is rule 14's correlative pair on the מִן and the waw; the עַד of the second member takes the of written where that member's preposition stands (rules 11, 26), and the later וְעַד divides as rule 16 directs, the waw taking the bare even and the עַד taking unto.
